sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (her move loop, 7 frames): skipping forward on her little feet, the staff held upright in her near hand, Pix floating at the picture's upper left as in image 1, the hat bobbing, the FEET CHANGING OVER as written for each frame
sheets.weapons: THE STAFF goes where the pale figure has it, frame by frame (image 3 shows it in colour): the twisted wooden staff with its curled top, as long as in image 1, in her near white-gloved hand - upright, pointed out level or raised overhead, as the pale figure has it. PIX, the little violet fairy, floats where the pale figure has him (the picture's upper left), as big as in image 1. Only her: no sparkles, no magic bolts, no stars, no glow.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR FOOT: the NEAR little black boot (the lighter one) flat on the ground line under her robe; the FAR boot (the darker one) lifted behind it, off the ground. Frame 2: PASSING: the FAR boot passing forward right beside the planted near one, just off the ground - the two feet side by side under the robe. The two feet TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-3 the NEAR boot (the lighter one) carries her and the FAR boot comes forward, in frames 4-7 the FAR boot (the darker one) carries her and the NEAR boot comes forward - frames 1 and 4 must show a different foot planted. Draw the feet AS WRITTEN for each frame, not the pale figure's (the old 1x feet are too small to read; runs drawn after them kept the same legs in all frames: 「走路没有换腿」). The robe, the hat, the hair, the staff and Pix follow the pale figure; her long robe hides her legs - only the little boots show under it.
